text: In February 2024 Alexey Taycher sold the leasing company Transfin-M to the company's management: 70% of the shares went to the closed-end mutual investment fund 'Investservis' under the management of management company 'Aurum Investment', and 30% to the closed-end fund 'Taler' under the management of OOO 'Tetis Kapital', according to a information disclosure of 22 February 2024.
short: Taycher sold Transfin-M to its management: funds Investservis (Aurum Investment) 70% and Taler (Tetis Kapital) 30%.

source.name: RBC: У «Трансфин-М» сменился владелец (archived copy)
source.note: Translation: '70% of the shares went to the closed-end mutual fund Investservis managed by MC Aurum Investment, 30% to ZPIF Taler managed by Tetis Kapital, per the disclosure of 22 February.' RBC's headline: Taycher sold Transfin-M to the company's management.
source.quote: 70% акций получил закрытый паевой инвестиционный фонд (ЗПИФ) «Инвестсервис» под управлением УК «Аурум Инвестмент» , 30% — ЗПИФ «Талер» под управлением ООО «Тетис Кэпитал» , следует из данных раскрытия информации от 22 февраля
